Name: DE-BillingClients
Statement:
select  cl.Oid as BillingClientId,
        cl.Name as BillingClient,
        cl.Active as IsActive,
        c.Oid as CompanyId,
        c.Name as Company,
        c.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
        p.Oid as PaymentConditionId,
        p.Name as PaymentCondition,
        cl.Code,
        cl.NameAndExternalId,
        cl.ExternalId,
        rc.Name as RateCard,
        rc.Oid as RateCardId,
        rcc.Name as RateCardColumn,
        pt.Name as PriceTable,
        pt.Oid as PriceTableId,
        ptc.Name as PriceTableColumn,
        u.Name as CreatedBy,
        us.Name as ModifiedBy,
        u.Id as CreatedById,
        us.Id as ModifiedById,
        u.HasImage as CreatedByHasImage,
        us.HasImage as ModifiedByHasImage,
        cl.CreatedOnUtc as CreatedOn,
        cl.ModifiedOnUtc as ModifiedOn,
        cl.Street,
        cl.Street2,
        cl.StateProvince,
        cl.ZipPostal,
        cl.TaxPayerNumber,
        cl.Contact,
        cou.Name as Country,
        ct.Name as City
from    Client cl
            join Company c on c.Oid = cl.Company
            left join PaymentCondition p on p.Oid = cl.PaymentCondition
            left join UserLookup u on u.Id = cl.CreatedBy 
            left join UserLookup us on us.Id = cl.ModifiedBy
            left join RateCard rc on rc.Oid = cl.RateCard
            left join RateCardColumn rcc on rcc.Oid = cl.RateCardColumn
            left join PriceTable pt on pt.Oid = cl.PriceTable
            left join PriceTableColumn ptc on ptc.Oid = cl.PriceTableColumn
            left join Country cou on cou.Oid = cl.BillingClientCountry
            left join City ct on ct.Oid = cl.BillingClientCity
where   cl.GCRecord is null
